usta-1114101.name: Walnut Bandırma
usta-1114101.description: Walnut Bandırma brings the distinctive flavour of walnuts together with coconut flavouring. Its soft texture offers a delicious alternative for lovers of traditional sweets.
usta-1114101.ingredients: sugar, corn starch, water, acidity regulator (citric acid), walnuts, coconut flavouring.
usta-1114101.allergenInfo: Contains walnuts. Please consider these allergens before consuming.
usta-1114101.servingSuggestion: For the best flavour, allow refrigerated products to rest at room temperature for 2 hours before serving.
usta-1114101.storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
usta-1114101.longTermStorage:

For the best flavour, thaw at +4 °C for 2 hours, then allow to rest at room temperature for 2 hours before serving. Thawing directly at room temperature may make the product excessively soft or firm.

Do not refreeze thawed products.
